name: autopilot_search_tick
description: Host-neutral runtime scheduler for automatic task-aware memory search. Given an agent event (PI context/tool_result/save_point, Claude Code PostToolUse, Cursor after-agent, etc.), it decides whether a concrete memory-backed uncertainty exists. When it does, it runs bounded search_memory and returns context_injection for the next provider request; otherwise it returns the skip reason. This is not a session-start wake replacement.

event_name.description: Normalized or native event name, e.g. context, tool_result, PostToolUse, prepareNextTurn.

project_name.description: Project name (defaults to active project when omitted).

current_task.description: Current task or subtask the agent is working on.

messages.description: Optional recent message/event snippets from the host.

tool_result.description: Tool result or compact error payload for tool_result events.

is_error.description: Whether the tool result is an error.

candidate_claims.description: Durable memory/rule claims being considered at a save point.

changed_files.description: Files touched or in scope for this event.

recent_queries.description: Recent autopilot queries to suppress duplicates.

include_provisional.description: Allow provisional auto-promoted truth in the search path.

budget_tokens.description: Advisory budget for the bounded search tick.

retrieval_profile.description: Optional retrieval profile passed through to search_memory.
